items.title: Vision Zero Annual Project Update, DSD-2026-108, DSD-2026-108
notes:
The Committee considered Development Services Department report DSD-2026-108, dated March 30, 2026, recommending that the 2026 Vision Zero Annual Update be received and, that staff be directed to implement the proposed 2026 safety improvements as outlined in Report DSD-2026-108. 

C. Payne, Project Manager, Transportation Safety provided an overview of the report. B. Cronkite, Director, Transportation Services was in attendance to respond to questions of the Committee.

items.title: Kitchener 2051 New Official Plan Updated Draft, DSD-2026-151
notes:
The Committee considered Development Services Department report DSD-2026-151, dated April 7, 2026, recommending staff consider the submissions provided on the second draft Official Plan, including submissions made at the April 20, 2026, Council meeting. It was noted written submissions were received by A. Jackson, B. Trotter, D. Koehler, D. Reid, J. Seally, S. Savor, T. Slomke, D. Garett, J. Garrett, N. Jenson, J. Santi, K. Doehn, H. Jaeger, P. Nickels, R. Kam, H. Price, R. Kelly-Ruetz, Canada National (CN) Rail, and Waterloo Region Housing (WRH).

J. Zunic, Senior Planner, and C. Emeadi, Community Working Group member, provided an overview of the report. N. Goss, Manager. Policy and Research, and R. Bustamante, Director, Planning and Housing Policy, were in attendance to respond to questions from the Committee.

K. Kresky, D. Kresky, G. Shepherd, J. Kossowski, K. Bockasten, M. Reid, D. Natale, A. Sinclair, K. Doehn, S. Nevin, M. Asling, E. Elliott, and D. Aston were in attendance to provide feedback on the New Official Plan Updated Draft, as outlined in Development Services Department report, DSD‑2026‑151. Concerns were raised including but not limited to: maintaining existing land use permissions within Employment Areas; the proposed Westmount neighbourhood city structure and land use approach; the need for clearer direction on Commercial First policies and retaining/replacing commercial floor area over time; and requests to expand Strategic Growth Areas.

items.title: Recess and Reconvene
notes: The Planning and Strategic Initiatives Committee then recessed at 9:11 p.m. and reconvened at 9:23 p.m., Chaired by Councillor P. Singh with all members present.

items.title: Kitchener 2051 New Official Plan Updated Draft, DSD-2026-151 Cont'd
notes:
The Committee resumed consideration of the Development Services Department report DSD-2026-151, dated April 7, 2026, recommending staff consider the submissions provided on the second draft Official Plan, including submissions made at the April 20, 2026, Council meeting.

H. Price, S. Nabi, R. Kelly‑Ruetz, M. Smith, and P. Chauvin addressed the Committee regarding the New Official Plan Updated Draft and further noted concerns related to maintaining existing land use permissions within Employment Areas, providing clearer direction on “Commercial First” policies, and expanding/clarifying Strategic Growth Areas.

Councillor M. Johnston and Mayor B. Vrbanovic left the meeting at this time.

S. Zahanov noted support for the Updated Draft Official Plan and advocated for higher-density residential zoning and increased affordable housing, indicating support for accommodating growth within established neighbourhoods.

Councillor Margaret Johnston and Mayor B. Vrbanovic entered the meeting at this time

Councillor P. Singh left the meeting at this time. Councillor D. Chapman assumed Chair.

C. Patel and R. Khunkhun provided comments on the Updated Draft Official Plan and requested that the land use designation for 239 Mill Street be revised.

Councillor P. Singh entered the meeting at this time, and resumed Chair.

Councillor M. Johnston provided direction to staff to reflect Westmount neighbourhood concerns by considering a “one neighbourhood, one land use designation” approach, applying a single Cultural Heritage Landscape designation with comprehensive cultural heritage recognition, and limiting building height to a three‑storey maximum, consistent with matters raised through the residents of the Westmount neighborhood's submissions.

In response to questions from the Committee, J. Zunic advised that staff would follow up with individuals who submitted verbal and written submissions on site-specific matters and will consider the feedback received in preparing the final Official Plan. N. Goss clarified that the recommendation before the Committee directs staff to consider comments from delegations, written submissions, and the Committee in finalizing the plan. Staff further noted that the project is anticipated to return to the Committee on or about May 25, 2026 or June 1, 2026.
